sanskrit: payo deveṣu paya oṣadhīṣu paya āśāsu payo 'ntarikṣe | tan me dhātā savitā ca dhattāṃ viśve tad devā abhi saṃ gṛṇantu ||
english: Milk-sap among the gods, milk-sap in the herbs, milk-sap in the quarters, milk-sap in the atmosphere — may Dhātṛ and Savitṛ bestow that upon me; may all the gods proclaim it together.

sanskrit: payo yad apsu paya usriyāsu paya utseṣūta parvateṣu | tan me dhātā savitā ca dhattāṃ viśve tad devā abhi saṃ gṛṇantu ||
english: The milk-sap that is in the waters, the milk-sap in the cows, the milk-sap in the springs and likewise in the mountains — may Dhātṛ and Savitṛ bestow that upon me; may all the gods proclaim it together.

sanskrit: yan mṛgeṣu paya āviṣṭam asti yad ejati patati yat patatriṣu | tan me dhātā savitā ca dhattāṃ viśve tad devā abhi saṃ gṛṇantu ||
english: The milk-sap that is lodged in the beasts, that which stirs and flies, that which is in the birds — may Dhātṛ and Savitṛ bestow that upon me; may all the gods proclaim it together.

sanskrit: yāni payāṃsi divy ārpitāni yāny antarikṣe bahudhā bahūni | teṣām īśāne vaśinī no adya pra dattāṃ dyāvāpṛthivī ahṛṇīyamāne ||
english: The milk-essences that are set in heaven, those manifold and numerous ones in the atmosphere — the two sovereign mistresses who rule over them: may Dyāvāpṛthivī, free from wrath, bestow them upon us today.

sanskrit: āganmemāṃ samitiṃ viśvarūpāṃ yasyāṃ pūrvam avadad deva ekaḥ | sā naḥ sūktair jujuṣāṇā samīcy asmān vṛṇītāṃ sumanasyamānā ||
english: We have come to this all-formed assembly in which of old the one god spoke; may she — the true assembly (samīcī), delighting in our hymns — benevolently choose us.

sanskrit: iyaṃ devī samitir viśvarūpā śilpaṃ kṛṇvānā carati janeṣu | tāṃ rājānaḥ kavayo hṛtsu ketair arājānaś ca vadanaiḥ punanti ||
english: This divine assembly, all-formed, performing her craft, moves among the peoples; her the kings and the seers purify with understanding in their hearts, and the common folk purify with their words of mouth.

sanskrit: agniṃ sāmityam upa saṃ sadema vācā priyaṃ madhumatyā vadantaḥ | somo rājā varuṇo mitradharmā mayi śremāṇam upa saṃ namantu ||
english: May we sit down together by the assembly-fire, speaking with dear and honeyed speech; may King Soma, may Varuṇa of Mitra's ordinance bend their exertions toward me.

sanskrit: yo vaḥ śuṣmo hṛdaye yo bāhvor yaś ca cakṣuṣi | jihvāyā agre yo manyus taṃ vo vi nayāmasi ||
english: Whatever fierce heat is in your hearts, whatever is in your arms, and whatever is in your eyes — the anger that sits at the tip of the tongue — that we lead away from you.

sanskrit: triṣ kuṣṭhāsi vṛtrāj jātas trir divas pari jajñiṣe | triḥ somāj jajñiṣe tvaṃ trir ādityebhyas pari ||
english: O Kuṣṭha, you are thrice-born from Vṛtra; three times you were born down from heaven; three times you were born from Soma; three times from the Ādityas.

sanskrit: jīvalaṃ naghāriṣaṃ jayatkam aparājitam | taṃ tvāmṛtasyeśānaṃ rājan kuṣṭhā vadāmasi ||
english: Life-giving, harmless, victorious, unconquered — you who are lord of the immortal: O king Kuṣṭha, we thus address you.

sanskrit: antarā dyāvāpṛthivī antarikṣam idaṃ mahat | tatrāmṛtasyeśānaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ devā abadhnata ||
english: Between heaven and earth, in this great atmosphere — there the gods bound Kuṣṭha, the lord of the immortal.

sanskrit: kuṣṭho 'si devakṛto himavadbhyo nirābhṛtaḥ | tīkṣṇābhir abhribhiḥ khātaḥ sa cakarthārasaṃ viṣam ||
english: You are Kuṣṭha, fashioned by the gods, brought forth from the Himālaya, dug up with sharp spades — you have cut out the virulence of poison.
